name: QEF Solver Initialization
definition: Prepares the QEF system for solving by computing the centroid and assembling the symmetric matrix $A^T A$ and vector $A^T b$.
summary: QEF Solver Initialization computes the centroid and assembles the symmetric linear system matrices, transitioning from raw data accumulation to constructing the solvable algebraic structure for the Dual Contouring solver.
